title: Area3D shape signals behave differently with Jolt Physics
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.dev [e45cc68092906465df3ea9e820a7c77d602addb1] ### System information Godot v4.5.dev (e45cc6809) - Fedora Linux 42 (Adams) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) ### Issue description This is a formal issue for the deliberate discrepancy between Godot Physics and Jolt Physics that came as a result of #106918[^1]. In short, because of the reference counting of area shape overlaps introduced in #106918, Jolt Physics will not behave quite the same as Godot Physics in terms of the shape enter/exit events that are emitted when you (for example) have an Area3D that completely envelops a multi-shape RigidBody3D and then add/remove/move shapes from that RigidBody3D. You'll see this clearly in the provided MRP, where Godot Physics outputs the following:
[Click to expand]

``` [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 0 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 5 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 6 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 5 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 6 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 5 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 5 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 exited [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited ```

... but Jolt Physics instead outputs the following:
[Click to expand]

``` [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 6 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 5 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 entered [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 0 entered [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 6 exited [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 5 exited [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 4 exited [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 3 exited [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 2 exited [MyRigidBody] ---- Removing shape at index 1 ---- [MyArea] 'MyRigidBody' shape at index 1 exited ```

While the Jolt Physics output maybe isn't strictly incorrect, you can't actually rely on those signal emissions to mirror the exact state changes somewhere else, unlike with Godot Physics, which may be a problem for some. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Run the MRP with Godot Physics. 2. Run the MRP with Jolt Physics. 3. Observe the difference in output. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [area-shape-shifts.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20565134/area-shape-shifts.zip) [^1]: Note that this was severely broken in other ways before this PR, so this was not a regression per se.
